descriptionChirho: The office, role, and function of the priest, encompassing the sacerdotal privileges and responsibilities assigned to the Aaronic/Levitical line. Used of the priesthood as an institution (Exod 29:9; 40:15; Num 16:10; 25:13; Josh 18:7; 1 Sam 2:36; Ezra 2:62; Neh 7:64; 13:29), with various pronominal suffixes (your priesthood, Num 18:1,7; their priesthood, Num 3:10) and in plural (the priesthoods, 1 Sam 2:36). Multilingual glosses uniformly translate as sacerdocio (Spa), kahanah (Arb), Priesthood (Deu/Eng), yajakpad (Hin), jesajik (Kor).
